document.name: Document
document.line: A white desk: real pages at the full viewport and real logos, LinkedIn-style cards of fictional people, editorial lines with a yellow marker, charts under their app icon, the yellow chapter pages; real stock shots in a frame on the paper and GIFs as pinned prints; the filmed intro and cutbacks dressed with lockups behind the head.
document.engine: the article-video engine (engine.js F.*, fx.js, blocs.js B.*, theme.css) and the stock-shot frame (framed.js), copied into the template
